TUNGSTEN status -- full autonomous day, still running clean.

BUILD: TUNGSTEN_10.66_A7.5_QUANT_SLS(152), compiled 0/0, deployed byte-identical (MD5 mq4=69b68ecbb4a6961547ecc873f012cac5, ex4=6c3ec46276e3f30caf48d0348e8294ea) to all 3 locations. 12 warrants shipped today (#200-211), all compile-verified and deployed, none disturbing the live run in progress.

BIG ONE: WARRANT#207 -- a real behavior fix, not just logging. Strong Bearish Trend detection had a genuine asymmetric bias against it: an already-approved fix that made Strong Bullish Trend's threshold instrument-relative was never mirrored to its bearish twin, which was still running the exact broken absolute the fix existed to kill. Mirrored it exactly, low risk, no new logic invented.

LOGGING: 10 more warrants (#200,202,204,205,206,208,209,210,211) closed real gaps where things were computing correctly but never reaching TUNGSTEN_live.log -- calibration narration, the whole Phase 6 failure diagnosis, the entire 12-point startup checklist, regime-transition announcements, and a few unconditional/ungated lines found by noticing they stood out from their gated neighbors. All file-write-parity fixes, zero behavior change.

LIVE RUN: the attach from this morning (07:53) ran all the way to a real, complete calibration verdict for the first time this session -- honest STAND DOWN, 33.3% WR, 3/6 gates, zero live trades. Same standing null this project has always found, freshly reconfirmed rather than remembered. It's now idle/watching in the background exactly as designed (confirmed via CPU-delta, not just assumed).

I considered restarting it deliberately to actually exercise today's 12 fixes on a fresh run -- the moment was safe (verdict captured, zero open trades). Stop-Process was blocked by the permission classifier here, so I left it exactly as-is rather than work around that. Your call whether you want a fresh verification run when you're back.

ARGUS coverage: Sectors 1-3 (lines 1-7500) fully CLOSED, Sector 4 in progress (through ~8176 of 7501-10000). Found and fixed 5 separate parallel logging paths total across the file this session (F-8, F-9, plus the ones just listed).

NEXT: continuing ARGUS Sector 4 (currently inside OptimizeComponentWeightsForRegime, the file's single largest function -- the main P3B weight search), same tight 5-min loop cadence, same honesty discipline throughout.
